lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a repeating grid posterior to the gill slits, with vertical alignment forming distinct columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct, high-contrast elongated silhouettes are present near the ventral-pectoral transition, trailing posteriorly from the main body mass.
